entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Sri Roopak Chaubey, learned A.G.A. has raised a preliminary objection that against the order impugned dated 28.07.2020, an appeal lies under Section 76 of the Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006.
2.
At this stage, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the instant application with liberty to file an appeal.
3. Accordingly, the instant application is dismissed with liberty as prayed for.

4. Let the certified copy of the documents, if any, be returned to the counsel for the applicant as per the rules of the Court.
